files.apply_rules.sql:
select l.rule_id, l.kind, l.label, l.expected,
       coalesce(c.fields, 0) as fields_changed, coalesce(c.occ, 0) as occurrences, coalesce(s.skipped, 0) as skipped
from (select rule_id, 'link ' || action as kind,
             old_target || ' -> ' || coalesce(nullif(dest, ''), '(unlink)') as label, exp_present as expected
      from seo_repair.stage_link_rules
      union all
      select rule_id, 'fee ' || category, slug || ' / ' || col, 1 from seo_repair.stage_fee_rules) l
left join (select rule_id, count(*) as fields, sum(occurrences) as occ from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log
           where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run') group by rule_id) c using (rule_id)
left join (select rule_id, count(*) as skipped from seo_repair.seo_repair_skip_log
           where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run') group by rule_id) s using (rule_id)
order by l.rule_id
files.apply_skips.sql:
select reason, count(*) as n from seo_repair.seo_repair_skip_log where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run')
group by reason order by 2 desc, 1
files.apply_totals.sql:
select (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run') as run_id,
       (select count(*) from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run')) as field_changes,
       (select count(distinct (table_name, row_id, column_name)) from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log
         where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run')) as fields_changed,
       (select count(*) from seo_repair.seo_repair_backup_20261115 where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run')) as backups_written,
       (select count(*) from seo_repair.seo_repair_skip_log where run_id = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_apply_run')) as skips_logged
files.dry_fees_not_applying.sql:
with _seo_fee_rules as (select rule_id, t, rid, slug, col, ord, category, old_text, old_md5, new_text, pin from seo_repair.stage_fee_rules),
_seo_fee_eval as (
select r.rule_id, r.t, r.rid, r.slug, r.col, r.ord, r.old_md5, r.pin,
  md5(r.old_text) = r.old_md5 as lit_ok,
  coalesce(v.row_found, false) as row_found,
  v.val is not null as has_val,
  md5(v.val) as cur_md5,
  coalesce((length(v.val) - length(replace(v.val, r.old_text, ''))) / length(r.old_text), 0) as occ
from _seo_fee_rules r
left join lateral (
    select true as row_found, (case r.col when $seo$body_markdown$seo$ then x.body_markdown when $seo$content$seo$ then x.content when $seo$description$seo$ then x.description when $seo$og_description$seo$ then x.og_description when $seo$seo_description$seo$ then x.seo_description when $seo$seo_title$seo$ then x.seo_title end)::text as val
    from public.content_pages x where r.t = $seo$content_pages$seo$ and x.id = r.rid::uuid
) v on true
)
select rule_id, slug, col, occ, row_found, has_val, (pin is not null and pin = cur_md5) as pin_ok
from _seo_fee_eval
where rule_id is not null and not (lit_ok and has_val and occ = 1 and (pin is null or pin = cur_md5))
order by rule_id
files.dry_fees_summary.sql:
with _seo_fee_rules as (select rule_id, t, rid, slug, col, ord, category, old_text, old_md5, new_text, pin from seo_repair.stage_fee_rules),
_seo_fee_eval as (
select r.rule_id, r.t, r.rid, r.slug, r.col, r.ord, r.old_md5, r.pin,
  md5(r.old_text) = r.old_md5 as lit_ok,
  coalesce(v.row_found, false) as row_found,
  v.val is not null as has_val,
  md5(v.val) as cur_md5,
  coalesce((length(v.val) - length(replace(v.val, r.old_text, ''))) / length(r.old_text), 0) as occ
from _seo_fee_rules r
left join lateral (
    select true as row_found, (case r.col when $seo$body_markdown$seo$ then x.body_markdown when $seo$content$seo$ then x.content when $seo$description$seo$ then x.description when $seo$og_description$seo$ then x.og_description when $seo$seo_description$seo$ then x.seo_description when $seo$seo_title$seo$ then x.seo_title end)::text as val
    from public.content_pages x where r.t = $seo$content_pages$seo$ and x.id = r.rid::uuid
) v on true
),
st as (
  select e.*,
         case when not e.lit_ok then 'LITERAL DAMAGED'
              when not e.row_found then 'row missing'
              when not e.has_val then 'field is null'
              when e.occ = 0 then 'old_text absent (changed since snapshot, or already applied)'
              when e.occ > 1 then 'old_text occurs more than once'
              when e.pin is null then 'ok, but UNPINNED (apply refuses until pinned)'
              when e.pin <> e.cur_md5 then 'field md5 differs from pin'
              else 'ok' end as status
  from _seo_fee_eval e where e.rule_id is not null
)
select status, count(*) as fee_rules, count(distinct (t, rid, col)) as fields
from st group by status order by status
files.dry_links.sql:
with _seo_link_rules as (select rule_id, form, path, action, old_target, dest, exp_present, exp_ins, exp_change, tol, pat_ctx, repl_ctx, pat_md, pat_html from seo_repair.stage_link_rules),
_seo_pins as (select t, rid, col, md5 from seo_repair.stage_pins),
_seo_link_eval as (
select r.rule_id, k.t, k.rid, k.slug, k.col, md5(k.val) as cur_md5, pn.md5 as pin,
  (select count(*) from regexp_matches(k.val, r.pat_ctx, 'g'))::int as present,
  (case when r.action = 'REWRITE' then (select count(*) from regexp_matches(k.val, r.pat_ctx, 'g'))
        else (select count(*) from regexp_matches(k.val, r.pat_md, 'g'))
           + (select count(*) from regexp_matches(k.val, r.pat_html, 'g')) end)::int as handled,
  exists (select 1 from regexp_split_to_table(k.val, $seo$\n|<(?:/?(?:[Pp]|[Ll][Ii]|[Uu][Ll]|[Oo][Ll]|[Hh][1-6]|[Dd][Ii][Vv]|[Tt][RrDdHh]|[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]|[Bb][Ll][Oo][Cc][Kk][Qq][Uu][Oo][Tt][Ee]|[Ss][Ee][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]|[Dd][DdTt])\M[^>]*|[Bb][Rr]\s*/?)>$seo$) b
          where b ~ r.pat_ctx and b ~* $seo$insur|liabil|coverage|\mcovered\M|claim|damage|waiver|injur|indemn|\mseguros?\M|responsabilidad|cobertura|reclam|\mdaños?\M|lesi[oó]n$seo$) as ins
from (
  select f.t, f.rid, f.slug, f.col, f.val, n.form, n.path
  from (
    select $seo$content_pages$seo$::text as t, x.id::text as rid, x.slug, $seo$content$seo$::text as col, x.content as val
    from public.content_pages x where x.content ~* $seo$poolrentalnearme|\]\(\s*<?/|href$seo$
    union all
    select $seo$content_pages$seo$::text as t, x.id::text as rid, x.slug, $seo$body_markdown$seo$::text as col, x.body_markdown as val
    from public.content_pages x where x.body_markdown ~* $seo$poolrentalnearme|\]\(\s*<?/|href$seo$
    union all
    select $seo$blog_posts$seo$::text as t, x.id::text as rid, x.slug, $seo$content$seo$::text as col, x.content as val
    from public.blog_posts x where x.content ~* $seo$poolrentalnearme|\]\(\s*<?/|href$seo$
  ) f
  cross join lateral (
    select distinct
      case when m[1] ~* '^https?://poolrentalnearme\.com' then 'n' else 'w' end as form,
      coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(
        regexp_replace(m[1], '^https?://(www\.)?poolrentalnearme\.com', '', 'i'), '#', 1), '?', 1), '/+$', ''), ''), '/') as path
    from regexp_matches(f.val, $seo$(?:\]\(\s*<?|[Hh][Rr][Ee][Ff]\s*=\s*\\?["'])([^)\s"'<>\\]+)$seo$, 'g') m
    where m[1] ~* '^https?://(www\.)?poolrentalnearme\.com' or (m[1] ~ '^/' and m[1] !~ '^//')
  ) n
) k
join _seo_link_rules r on r.form = k.form and r.path = k.path
left join _seo_pins pn on pn.t = k.t and pn.rid = k.rid and pn.col = k.col
),
_seo_prior as (
  select split_part(x, ':', 1) as rule_id, split_part(x, ':', 2)::int as n
  from unnest(string_to_array(
    case when to_regclass('seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log') is null then ''
         else coalesce((xpath('/row/j/text()', query_to_xml(
           'select string_agg(rule_id || '':'' || n, '','') as j from (select rule_id, count(*) as n from '
           || '(select distinct rule_id, table_name, row_id, column_name from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log '
           || 'where rolled_back_at is null) d group by rule_id) x', false, true, '')))[1]::text, '') end, ',')) x
  where x <> ''
),
agg as (
  select r.rule_id, r.action, r.old_target, coalesce(nullif(r.dest, ''), '(unlink)') as dest,
         r.exp_present, r.tol,
         count(e.rule_id)::int as present_rows,
         (count(*) filter (where e.handled > 0 and not e.ins and (e.pin = e.cur_md5)))::int as would_change,
         (count(*) filter (where e.handled > 0 and not e.ins and (e.pin is distinct from e.cur_md5)))::int as field_guard_skip,
         (count(*) filter (where e.ins))::int as insurance_skip,
         (count(*) filter (where e.present > e.handled and not e.ins))::int as unsupported_form_rows,
         coalesce(sum(e.handled) filter (where not e.ins and (e.pin = e.cur_md5)), 0)::int as occurrences,
         coalesce((select p.n from _seo_prior p where p.rule_id = r.rule_id), 0)::int as already_applied
  from _seo_link_rules r left join _seo_link_eval e on e.rule_id = r.rule_id
  where r.rule_id is not null
  group by r.rule_id, r.action, r.old_target, r.dest, r.exp_present, r.tol
)
select rule_id, action, old_target, dest, exp_present as expected_present_20261115, present_rows as present_now,
       would_change, field_guard_skip, insurance_skip, already_applied, unsupported_form_rows, occurrences,
       case when abs(would_change + insurance_skip + already_applied - exp_present) <= tol then 'ok'
            else 'OUT OF TOLERANCE (apply aborts)' end as verdict
from agg
order by rule_id

    where m[1] ~* '^https?://(www\.)?poolrentalnearme\.com' or (m[1] ~ '^/' and m[1] !~ '^//')
  ) n

join _seo_link_rules r on r.form = k.form and r.path = k.path
left join _seo_pins pn on pn.t = k.t and pn.rid = k.rid and pn.col = k.col
)
select e.rule_id, r.old_target, e.t as table_name, e.slug, e.col as column_name,
       case when e.pin is null then 'not in pin read' else 'changed since pin read' end as why
from _seo_link_eval e join _seo_link_rules r using (rule_id)
where e.handled > 0 and not e.ins and (e.pin is distinct from e.cur_md5)

files.dry_pins.sql:
select (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'pin_set_sha256') as pin_set_sha256,
  (select coalesce(encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(t || E'\t' || rid || E'\t' || col || E'\t' || md5 || E'\n', '' order by t collate "C", rid collate "C", col collate "C"), 'UTF8')), 'hex'), encode(sha256(''::bytea), 'hex')) from seo_repair.stage_pins) as pin_set_sha256_now,
  (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'pinned_fields') as pinned_fields,
  (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'pinned_at') as pinned_at,
  (select count(*) from seo_repair.stage_pins where md5 = 'MISSING') as pins_missing_field,
  (select count(*) from seo_repair.stage_fee_rules where pin is null) as fee_rules_without_pin,
  (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'reviewed_pin_set_sha256') as reviewed_pin_set_sha256,
  (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'staged_rules_digest') as staged_rules_digest
files.dry_preflight_columns.sql:
select n.t as table_name, n.c as column_name, coalesce(ic.data_type, 'MISSING') as data_type
from (values
    ($seo$blog_posts$seo$, $seo$content$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$body_markdown$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$content$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$description$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$og_description$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$seo_description$seo$),
    ($seo$content_pages$seo$, $seo$seo_title$seo$)) n(t, c)
left join information_schema.columns ic
  on ic.table_schema = 'public' and ic.table_name = n.t and ic.column_name = n.c
union all
select ic.table_name, ic.column_name, ic.data_type from information_schema.columns ic
where ic.table_schema = 'public' and ic.table_name in ('content_pages', 'blog_posts') and ic.column_name in ('id', 'updated_at')
order by 1, 2
files.dry_preflight_triggers.sql:
select event_object_table as table_name, trigger_name, action_timing, event_manipulation, action_statement
from information_schema.triggers
where event_object_schema = 'public' and event_object_table in ('content_pages', 'blog_posts')
order by 1, 2, 4
files.rollback_skipped.sql:
select table_name, row_id, slug, column_name, reason
from seo_repair.seo_repair_rollback_log
where rollback_run = (select v from seo_repair.stage_meta where k = 'last_rollback_run') and status = 'skipped'
order by table_name, slug, column_name
files.verify_changed.sql:
with last as (
  select distinct on (table_name, row_id, column_name) table_name, row_id, column_name, slug, new_md5, run_id
  from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log where rolled_back_at is null
  order by table_name, row_id, column_name, id desc
)
select l.table_name, l.slug, l.column_name, l.run_id,
       case when c.id is null and b.id is null then 'row gone' else 'value changed after the repair' end as state
from last l
left join public.content_pages c on l.table_name = 'content_pages' and c.id = l.row_id::uuid
left join public.blog_posts b on l.table_name = 'blog_posts' and b.id = l.row_id::uuid
where md5(case l.table_name when 'content_pages' then (case l.column_name when $seo$body_markdown$seo$ then c.body_markdown when $seo$content$seo$ then c.content when $seo$description$seo$ then c.description when $seo$og_description$seo$ then c.og_description when $seo$seo_description$seo$ then c.seo_description when $seo$seo_title$seo$ then c.seo_title end)
                            when 'blog_posts' then (case l.column_name when $seo$content$seo$ then b.content end) end)
      is distinct from l.new_md5
order by 1, 2, 3
files.verify_totals.sql:
with last as (
  select distinct on (table_name, row_id, column_name) table_name, row_id, column_name, new_md5
  from seo_repair.seo_repair_change_log where rolled_back_at is null
  order by table_name, row_id, column_name, id desc
)
select count(*) as repaired_fields,
       count(*) filter (where md5(case l.table_name when 'content_pages' then (case l.column_name when $seo$body_markdown$seo$ then c.body_markdown when $seo$content$seo$ then c.content when $seo$description$seo$ then c.description when $seo$og_description$seo$ then c.og_description when $seo$seo_description$seo$ then c.seo_description when $seo$seo_title$seo$ then c.seo_title end)
                            when 'blog_posts' then (case l.column_name when $seo$content$seo$ then b.content end) end) = l.new_md5)
